hooks.command: input=$(cat); wt=$(printf '%s' "$input" | grep -oE '/[^" ]+/\.claude/worktrees/[^" ]+' | head -1); [ -n "$wt" ] || wt=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); case "$wt" in */.claude/worktrees/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; main=${wt%%/.claude/worktrees/*}; if [ -d "$main/.vscode" ] && [ -d "$wt" ] && [ ! -e "$wt/.vscode" ]; then cp -R "$main/.vscode" "$wt/.vscode" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
